Implement the following requested change in the repository.

'ls' command alias no longer works

I noticed that the 'ls' alias for the 'list' command no longer works. 

For example:
```
$ dvc list local_dir
# This works fine

$ dvc ls local_dir
# This fails with a parser error
```

When trying to use the 'ls' alias, I get a parser error because the command is not recognized. This used to work in previous versions.

I can still use the full 'list' command without any issues, but the shorter 'ls' alias which was more convenient is broken.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: dvc/commands/ls/__init__.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
